queries.qTransferGroupData:
table duration=120m ts_current_job        
            | search FAB == "M14"    
			| eval A = case(trim(DESTMACHINENAME) == "4ABL_M10" ,1,0)         
			| eval B =  case(substr(trim(SOURCEMACHINENAME),0,7) == "4ABL330" ,1,0)         
			| eval C =  case(substr(trim(DESTMACHINENAME),0,4) == "4ALF" ,1,0)         
			| eval D =  case(substr(trim(SOURCEMACHINENAME),0,4) == "4ALF" ,1,0)         
			| eval E =  case(substr(trim(DESTMACHINENAME),0,4) == "4AFC" ,1,0)         
			| eval F =  case(substr(trim(SOURCEMACHINENAME),0,4) == "4AFC" ,1,0)        
			| stats sum(A) ,sum(B) ,sum(C) ,sum(D),sum(E),sum(F), count by CURRTIME       
			| rename count as TOTALCNT, sum(A) as M14AM10A ,sum(B) as M10AM14A, sum(C) as M14AM14B,sum(D) as M14BM14A,sum(E) as M14AM16,sum(F) as M16M14A       
			| eval M14AM10ASUM = M10AM14A + M14AM10A,      
			M14AM14BSUM = M14AM14B + M14BM14A,     
			M14AM16SUM = M14AM16 + M16M14A,  
			TIME = CURRTIME 
			| sort  CURRTIME 
			| fields CURRTIME, TOTALCNT, M14AM10A, M10AM14A, M14AM10ASUM, M14AM14B, M14BM14A, M14AM14BSUM, M14AM16, M16M14A, M14AM16SUM,TIME
		    | sort  CURRTIME
	        | sort limit=100 -TIME dst
queries.vhlRunRate:
dbquery mcs_m14
						SELECT 
						    SYSDATE AS TIME,
						    MACHINENAME,
						    'FOUP' AS CARRIERTYPE,
						    FOUP_VHL_UTIL AS VHLOPERRATE,
						    CASE 
						        WHEN FOUP_VHL_UTIL >= 80 THEN 'Y'
						        ELSE 'N'
						    END AS ALARM
						FROM 
						    vhlutl_vw
						UNION ALL
						SELECT 
						    SYSDATE AS TIME,
						    MACHINENAME,
						    'POD' AS CARRIERTYPE,
						    POD_VHL_UTIL AS VHLOPERRATE,
						    CASE 
						        WHEN POD_VHL_UTIL >= 80 THEN 'Y'
						        ELSE 'N'
						    END AS ALARM
						FROM 
						    vhlutl_vw
						| eval TIME = string(TIME,"yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm"), IDC_NM = "RUNRATE"
					    | fields TIME, MACHINENAME, CARRIERTYPE, VHLOPERRATE, ALARM, IDC_NM

queries.bridgeDetailCnvPortDownRate:
setq [
			table bridge_layout_detail
			| search EQP_TYP == "CD_M14CNV" and DET_IDC_NM == "*PORT*"
			| limit 1
			| fields EVENT_DT
			| rename EVENT_DT as LAST_DT
		]

		| table duration=2m bridge_layout_detail
		| search EVENT_DT == $("LAST_DT")
		| search EQP_TYP == "CD_M14CNV" and DET_IDC_NM == "*PORT*"
		| stats sum(int(RSLT_VAL)) as RSLT_VAL by EQP_TYP, DET_IDC_NM 
		| eval TOTAL_PORTS = case(DET_IDC_NM == "CD_PORTTOTAL", RSLT_VAL, 0)
		| eval INSERVICE_PORTS = case(DET_IDC_NM == "CD_PORTINSERVICE", RSLT_VAL, 0)
		| stats max(int(TOTAL_PORTS)) as TOTAL_PORTS, max(int(INSERVICE_PORTS)) as INSERVICE_PORTS by EQP_TYP
		| eval PORT_DOWN_RATE = round((TOTAL_PORTS - INSERVICE_PORTS) / TOTAL_PORTS * 100,2)
		| fields EQP_TYP, PORT_DOWN_RATE
queries.qtransferAltJobCnt:
fulltext from=START_DT to=END_DT (method=="createTransportJobHistory") from ts_transport_m14a
		| fields TIME_EX,STATE
		| search (STATE =="*ALT*" or STATE == "ERROR")
		| stats count(STATE) as DAY_CNT
		| eval FAB="M14A"

		| join type=left FAB[
			fulltext duration=1h (method=="createTransportJobHistory") from ts_transport_m14a
			| fields TIME_EX,STATE
			| search (STATE =="*ALT*" or STATE == "ERROR")
			| stats count(STATE) as HOUR_CNT
			| eval FAB="M14A"
		]

		| eval INCREASE_RATE = round((HOUR_CNT/DAY_CNT)*100)
queries.altJobMachineRate:
fulltext duration=1h (method=="createTransportJobHistory") from ts_transport_m14a
		| fields TIME_EX, STATE, DESTMACHINENAME, SOURCEMACHINENAME
		| search (STATE =="*ALT*" or STATE == "ERROR")
		| fields DESTMACHINENAME,STATE
		| rename DESTMACHINENAME as MACHINENAME 

		| union [
			fulltext duration=1h (method=="createTransportJobHistory") from ts_transport_m14a
			| fields TIME_EX, STATE, DESTMACHINENAME, SOURCEMACHINENAME
		 	| search (STATE =="*ALT*" or STATE == "ERROR")
			| fields SOURCEMACHINENAME,STATE
			| rename SOURCEMACHINENAME as MACHINENAME
		]

		| stats count(MACHINENAME) as CNT by MACHINENAME,STATE
		| eval FAB = "M14A"

		| join type=left FAB, STATE[
			fulltext duration=1h (method=="createTransportJobHistory") from ts_transport_m14a
			| fields TIME_EX, STATE, DESTMACHINENAME, SOURCEMACHINENAME
		 	| search (STATE =="*ALT*" or STATE == "ERROR")
			| fields DESTMACHINENAME,STATE
			| rename DESTMACHINENAME as MACHINENAME

			| union [
				fulltext duration=1h (method=="createTransportJobHistory") from ts_transport_m14a
				| fields TIME_EX, STATE, DESTMACHINENAME, SOURCEMACHINENAME
		 		| search (STATE =="*ALT*" or STATE == "ERROR")
				| fields SOURCEMACHINENAME,STATE
				| rename SOURCEMACHINENAME as MACHINENAME
			]

			| stats count(MACHINENAME) as TOTAL_CNT  by STATE
			| eval FAB = "M14A"
        ]

        | eval RATE_DT = round((CNT*100)/TOTAL_CNT,2)
queries.altJobMachineRate24h:
fulltext from=START_DT to=END_DT (method=="createTransportJobHistory") from ts_transport_m14a
		| fields TIME_EX, STATE, DESTMACHINENAME, SOURCEMACHINENAME
		| search (STATE =="*ALT*" or STATE == "ERROR")
		| fields DESTMACHINENAME,STATE,TIME_EX
		| rename DESTMACHINENAME as MACHINENAME 

		| union [
			fulltext from=20250730 to=20250731 (method=="createTransportJobHistory") from ts_transport_m14a
			| fields TIME_EX, STATE, DESTMACHINENAME, SOURCEMACHINENAME
		 	| search (STATE =="*ALT*" or STATE == "ERROR")
			| fields SOURCEMACHINENAME,STATE,TIME_EX
			| rename SOURCEMACHINENAME as MACHINENAME
		]

		| search in(MACHINENAME,MACHINELIST)
		| eval TIME_EX = datetrunc(date(TIME_EX,"yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss"), "1h")
		| stats count(MACHINENAME) as CNT by MACHINENAME,TIME_EX
        | stats avg(CNT) as DAY_CNT by MACHINENAME
        | eval DAY_CNT = round(DAY_CNT)
queries.qtransferAltJobCnt24h:
fulltext from=START_DT to=END_DT (method=="createTransportJobHistory") from ts_transport_m14a
		 | fields TIME_EX,STATE
		 | search in(STATE,STATELIST)
		 | eval TIME_EX = datetrunc(date(TIME_EX,"yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss"), "1h")
     	 | stats count(STATE) as HOUR_CNT by STATE,TIME_EX
         | stats avg(HOUR_CNT) as AVG_VAL by STATE 
         | eval AVG_VAL = round(AVG_VAL,2)
queries.SELECT_AWS_IDC_HISTORY:
dbquery star_m14
			SELECT *
			FROM AWS_IDC_DATA_HIS
			WHERE IDC_NM IN (
				'M14.STRATE.NONN2.STORAGERATIO',
				'M14.SORTER.ABN.SORTERWAITCOUNTOVER',
				'M14.SORTER.ABN.CUSORTERWAITCOUNTOVER',
				'M14.QUE.ALL.CURRENTQCOUNT',
				'M14.QUE.ALL.CURRENTQCNT',
				'M14.QUE.STK.MANUALOUTCOUNT',
				'M14.QUE.SENDFAB.VERTICALQUEUECOUNT',
				'M14.STRATE.STB.NONN2STORAGERATIO'
			)
			AND CRT_TM >= SYSDATE - INTERVAL '10' MINUTE

			| stats avg(IDC_VAL) as IDC_VAL by IDC_NM
			| eval IDC_VAL = round(IDC_VAL, 1)
			| pivot last(IDC_VAL) as IDC_VAL for IDC_NM

			| fields
            	M14.STRATE.NONN2.STORAGERATIO,
				M14.SORTER.ABN.SORTERWAITCOUNTOVER,
				M14.SORTER.ABN.CUSORTERWAITCOUNTOVER,
				M14.QUE.ALL.CURRENTQCOUNT,
				M14.QUE.ALL.CURRENTQCNT,
				M14.QUE.STK.MANUALOUTCOUNT,
				M14.QUE.SENDFAB.VERTICALQUEUECOUNT,
				M14.STRATE.STB.NONN2STORAGERATIO

queries.SELECT_M14TOM10LFT_DOWN_RATE: dbquery mcs_m14a SELECT 'CD_M14LFT' AS EQP_TYP, ROUND( (COUNT(MACHINENAME) - COUNT(CASE WHEN STATE = 'INSERVICE' AND BANNED = 'F' THEN 1 END)) / COUNT(MACHINENAME) * 100, 2 ) AS PORT_DOWN_RATE FROM nt_r_unit where machinename like '4ABL33%' and PORTTYPE='LP' and name not like '%MI%' and name not like '%MO%' and name not like '%M_IN%' and name not like '%M_OUT%' and name not like '%OUT%F'
queries.SELECT_M14LFT_DOWN_RATE: dbquery mcs_m14b SELECT 'CD_M14ZT' AS EQP_TYP, ROUND( (COUNT(MACHINENAME) - COUNT(CASE WHEN STATE = 'INSERVICE' AND BANNED = 'F' THEN 1 END)) / COUNT(MACHINENAME) * 100, 2 ) AS PORT_DOWN_RATE FROM nt_r_unit WHERE machinename LIKE '4ALF%' AND PORTTYPE = 'LP' AND name NOT LIKE '%MI%' AND name NOT LIKE '%MO%' AND name NOT LIKE 'SEND%'
queries.SELECT_M16A_STORAGE_UTIL: dbquery mcs_m16a SELECT '14' AS ID, TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDDHH24MI') AS EVENT_DT, 'ALL' AS FR_FAB_ID, 'ALL' AS TO_FAB_ID, ROUND((B.USED_VAL/A.TOTAL_VAL)*100) as CURR_VAL, A.IDC_NM, 'ALL' AS FR_LOC_NM, 'ALL' TO_LOC_NM FROM ( SELECT 'CD_M163FSTORAGEUTIL' AS IDC_NM, COUNT(NAME) AS TOTAL_VAL FROM port_vw where shop='M16HUB' AND unitkind='shelf' AND state='INSERVICE' AND BANNED='F' ) A , ( SELECT 'CD_M163FSTORAGEUTIL' AS IDC_NM, COUNT(NAME) AS USED_VAL FROM port_vw where shop='M16HUB' AND unitkind='shelf' AND STATE='INSERVICE' AND BANNED='F' AND (OCCUPIED='T' or RESERVED='T') ) B WHERE A.IDC_NM = B.IDC_NM
